🚀 Early Access Release: Exciting New Features Unveiled!

Hello Survivors!

We’re thrilled to announce that our game is officially live in Early Access on Steam! Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the development, and we're excited to share some of the major features that are now part of the game. Here’s what’s new:

🔗 Steam SDK Integration
We’ve successfully integrated the Steam SDK, making it easier for you to connect with friends and keep track of your achievements. This integration is just the beginning, paving the way for a seamless gaming experience with all the perks of the Steam platform. Expect more features like Steam Cloud, Workshop, and Achievements in future updates!

🕹️ Steam Multiplayer Sessions
Multiplayer is finally here! You can now host and join multiplayer sessions directly through Steam. Gather your friends or meet new players as you dive into the apocalypse together. Teamwork is key to survival—watch each other’s backs and conquer the undead as a squad.

🧙‍♂️ Character Selection
Introducing our brand-new character selection feature! Choose from a roster of unique characters, each with their own backstory and skills. Whether you prefer a sharpshooter, a medic, or a melee expert, there’s a character for every playstyle. Currently 2 characters are playable with customization options and more characters on the way, so stay tuned!

❤️ Health System/Death and Spectating
Survival isn’t just about fighting; it’s about staying alive. We’ve implemented a comprehensive health system that tracks your vitality during intense battles. If the worst happens and you succumb to the dangers of the world, you’ll enter spectate mode—watch your teammates continue the fight or learn from your mistakes for the next round.

⚔️ Melee Combat (Prototype)
We’ve sharpened our melee combat system to give you that visceral, up-close-and-personal feel in every fight. Swing, jab, and slash your way through hordes of enemies. Timing and precision are key, so practice your moves to master the art of melee combat!

🧟 First Look at Zombie NPCs (Prototype)
Say hello to our first zombie NPCs! These shambling horrors are still in their prototype phase and need a lot of work, but they’re the first of many. We’re focusing on AI improvements, animations, and varied behaviors to make these undead foes truly terrifying. Your feedback on how they perform will be crucial as we refine them.

This is just the beginning. We’re committed to improving and expanding the game based on your feedback and suggestions. Thank you for joining us on this journey—your support means everything to us.

Keep surviving, stay sharp, and as always, let us know what you think in the comments!

See you in the game, Humanity Remains Development Team
